meaning:
τυμπανίζω
(τύμπανον, a kettle-drum), [in LXX: 1Ki.21:13 (14) (17 pi?) * ;]
1. to beat a drum.
2. to torture by beating, beat to death (cf. Westc. on He, l.with): pass., Heb.11:35.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
